item.title: The Grave Of A Chief
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama, History

Page Layout (Optional): i plan to use alot of interview style dialouges since the foundation primarily documents the entity through the locals who tell its story

Elevator Pitch:
•A Mountain range is really the site of a massive battle between giant stone entities
•Local indian tribes allied with one entity and fought with it in the war with their magic
•The mountain was wounded, the tribes had to sacrifice their magic to save it. leaving them vulnerable to european invasion.
•The mountain has healed enough that the foundation has to appease the tribe to learn how to contain it, as having a literal mountain as an enemy is a problem.
•The tribe ultimatley aim to aide the foundation but they seek to regain their magical abilities, an idea the foundation is uncomfortable with.

Central Narrative: chief mountain is originally a kainai story of a giant chief who laid down and became a mountain. this is a story told to outsiders and the real story is that the stoney chief was nearly killed in a great battle, and the surrounding mountain range is a graveyard of the battle in which the people tread over their corpses. the local tribes are "keepers" of the mountain and tasked with keeping it alive

Hook/Attention-Grabber: a modern twist on a rare traditional indigenous story in order to help preserve one of my tribe's story, and to bring more indigenous stories besides the more well known bigfoot and wendigo.
